Executive Message

A Partnership for National Transformation

This programme represents a strategic alliance between DADTCO Group and MAEC Finance Capital to support the Democratic Republic of Congo through sovereign-backed, commercially-executed development financing.

🤝

Strategic Partnership

This brochure presents a strategic partnership between DADTCO Group and MAEC Finance Capital to support the Democratic Republic of Congo through a USD 2 Billion – 30-Year Strategic Financing Facility.

🏛️

Government Alignment

This programme is aligned with the Government's mandate, through the Social Fund, to reduce food prices, strengthen national supply chains and improve food security for the population.

🌍

Sustainable Impact

This solution combines sovereign support, international banking participation and commercial execution to deliver sustainable impact across the DRC.

03
The Project — Community Canteens Programme

Four Phases of National Food Security

A phased rollout from 2026 to 2050, building import capacity, processing infrastructure, agricultural production, and regional expansion.

01
2026 – 2028 · Phase 1
Import & Distribution Platform
Establish logistics platforms and nationwide distribution networks to stabilise food supply chains and create immediate price impact across urban and rural markets.
02
2027 – 2033 · Phase 2
Processing Facilities
Build agro-industrial infrastructure and processing plants to add value to local produce, reduce post-harvest losses, and create formal employment.
03
2030 – 2040 · Phase 3
Agricultural Production
Expand agricultural infrastructure and support over 50,000 farmer livelihoods nationwide through mechanisation, inputs, and guaranteed offtake.
04
2035 – 2050 · Phase 4
Regional Expansion
Scale operations regionally and achieve nationwide coverage by 2050, transforming the DRC into a net food exporter and regional breadbasket.
04
Key Outcomes

Measurable Impact Targets

Quantified deliverables spanning price stabilisation, logistics coverage, livelihood creation, and long-term contractual sustainability.

📉

Price Stabilisation

  • Average 30% reduction in food prices
  • More than 95% reduction in food import dependence
🚚

Logistics & Coverage

  • Integrated logistics & distribution networks
  • Nationwide coverage by 2050
👨‍🌾

Livelihoods & Households

  • Over 50,000 farmer livelihoods supported
  • 150,000 – 180,000 households initially, expanding to more than 4.7 million households in 15 years
📋

Contract & Sustainability

  • 25 years contract duration
  • 75% / 25% revenue sharing (DADTCO / Social Fund)
  • Sustainability over 25 years

Governance Framework

Strategic Principles

Five pillars ensuring sovereign control, commercial discipline, and shared prosperity throughout the programme lifecycle.

🛡️

Sovereign Control

Government retains full sovereign authority over strategic decisions and national assets, with parliamentary oversight of all sovereign borrowing.

⚙️

Commercial Execution

Private sector expertise drives efficient implementation and operational excellence, backed by EPC contracts and performance guarantees.

🔍

Transparency & Governance

Full audit trails, compliance frameworks, independent annual audits, and open reporting mechanisms ensure accountability.

♻️

Sustainability

Long-term environmental and economic sustainability embedded in every phase, with 25-year contract duration and renewable structures.

🤲

Shared Prosperity

Revenue sharing ensures benefits flow to both investors and the Congolese people through the Social Fund.
